context:
DONE 2026-10-24: PR #3388 merged as 3261331083da5f17fcef072f63d4438d801989b7 (head 604df7984, oracle SHIP, all required checks green). Evidence (Linux python:3.12, chdb 4.1.6): unmodified tests pass in all orders alone; with a leaked default client held open, 9/9 orders failed ('Table default.date already exists' or the usability probe table in the schema set); with the fixture all 9 leak orders and 5 plain orders pass. Not verified: the real CI leaker behind loadscope run 39825163467. The module-grouped scheduling revisit (deferral-1) is now unblocked.

description:
PROBLEM: tests/integration/test_ssb_clickhouse_integration.py::test_ssb_query_execution_clickhouse and ::test_ssb_schema_creation_without_engine failed with 'Table default.date already exists' when pytest-xdist ran the whole module on one worker (--dist loadscope) in CI run 39825163467 attempt 1 and its failed-job rerun; a full rerun with the same assignment passed (attempt 3). Under the default load distribution the two tests usually land on different workers, which hides the leak. Likely cause: in-process chDB (ClickHouseLocalClient) state persists across tests in one process, so a later test sees tables created by an earlier one. Not reproduced locally (the module skips without chdb).

CHANGE: make each test use an isolated chDB session/path (or drop what it creates) so the module passes in any order on one worker. Do not add retries or skips.
